name: ai-edit-bar
description: A row right under a pane's head with a text input and a button to its right that sends what was typed. Emits ds-ai-edit-submit with the prompt, ds-ai-edit-close on Escape; the host does the work.

props.name: label
props.description: The button's label: "Edit" first, "Regenerate" when pressing it runs the last request again.

rationale: Requested by the maintainer (2026-10-22) for Edit with AI on the Portfolio page: a block as high as the pane head (Header Preview, Included projects), holding an Input and a button to its right. No Figma node exists for it, so source is none. It reuses the input (filled) and text-button (secondary, regular weight, dotted underline: it acts within the page) as they are; only the row is new: head height (spacing-9 + spacing-5), head side padding (spacing-6), bg-surface, and the table hairline at the bottom. [data-busy] disables sending twice. Staged in local-components until the maintainer confirms it goes into dis-system.
a11y_notes: The input needs an aria-label from the host (no visible label); the button is a native button. Enter sends, Escape closes. Busy state is also set on the controls with disabled, so it is announced.
